# appgatesdp_brokered_rdp_entitlement (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Read-Only

- `app_shortcut` (Attributes) Shortcut configuration for the brokered session, displayed to the user in the client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--app_shortcut))
- `audio_redirection` (Boolean) Whether audio redirection from the remote host to the Client is permitted for this Entitlement.
- `clipboard_sharing` (Boolean) Whether clipboard sharing between Client and remote host is permitted for this Entitlement.
- `color_depth` (Number) Color depth, in bits per pixel, to negotiate with the RDP server for the session.
- `condition_logic` (String) Whether all the Conditions must succeed to have access to this Entitlement or just one.
- `conditions` (List of String) List of Condition IDs applied to this Entitlement.
- `created` (String) Create date.
- `credentials_name` (String) Name of the Credentials secret used for injection at session establishment. The secret must be of the Credentials or SSH Key type.
- `disabled` (Boolean) If true, the Entitlement will be disregarded during authorization.
- `disclosure_message` (String) Optional message shown to the user before the session starts. When set, the client requires the user to accept it before connecting.
- `file_transfer` (Boolean) Whether file transfers between Client and remote host are permitted for this Entitlement.
- `host` (String) Hostname or IP address of the target host.
- `host_optimization_exempted` (Boolean) Whether this Entitlement's host is exempt from Entitlement Optimization analysis. When true, traffic to the host is not considered when calculating the optimization score.
- `idle_timeout_minutes` (Number) Idle-session timeout in minutes. The session is terminated after this many minutes without user activity.
- `keyboard_layout` (String) Keyboard layout advertised to the RDP server. If omitted, the server's default layout is used.
- `monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) Whether sessions to this entitlement can be monitored live.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `optimization_score` (String) Indicates how optimized this Entitlement is based on usage data. Actions or hosts/ports/types/methods marked as optimizationExempt are excluded from this calculation. Licensed feature.
- `optimization_score_percentage` (Number) Numeric percentage score representing how optimized this Entitlement is based on usage data. Licensed feature.
- `port` (Number) Port number of the target host.
- `port_optimization_exempted` (Boolean) Whether this Entitlement's port is exempt from Entitlement Optimization analysis. When true, traffic on the port is not considered when calculating the optimization score.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes.
- `recording_enabled` (Boolean) Whether sessions to this entitlement are recorded.
- `resolution` (String) Screen resolution to negotiate with the RDP server for the session.
- `security_mode` (String) RDP security protocol to negotiate with the target host. `nla` (Network Level Authentication) is preferred; `any` lets the server pick.
- `site` (String) ID of the Site for this Entitlement.
- `site_name` (String) Name of the Site for this Entitlement. For convenience only.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.
- `windows_domain` (String) Optional Windows domain to use when authenticating against the RDP server. If omitted, no domain is sent.
